title: Drive files.copy now supports copying comments
summary: The Drive API now allows developers to include comments when duplicating files via the files.copy method.
details: A new boolean query parameter, `copyComments`, has been added to the `files.copy` method. When set to `true`, the operation will duplicate the comments associated with the source file to the new copy. The parameter defaults to `false`, maintaining existing behavior unless explicitly enabled by the developer.
